rationale: P identifies unintended vehicle braking as the behaviour that must be characterised to evaluate T, directly supported by H-3 and SG-3. Its declared operational scope follows H-3. Braking behaviour is itself the evaluation subject, rather than merely a control mechanism affecting another phenomenon. P does not incorporate sensing, computation, communication, failure mitigation, or mechanism timing requirements.
determining_elements: Whether the vehicle brakes unintentionally is directly relevant to the target 'Prevent unintended braking.'
The absence of visible obstacles or vehicles ahead is explicitly supported by H-3's operational situation.
The scope—straight-ahead driving on a less frequented urban road at 50 km/h in good weather—is supplied by H-3.
P remains focused on vehicle braking behaviour without extending to the mechanisms used to observe or control it.
